data.name: Chandrachur
data.long_meaning: Chandrachur is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Chur' meaning power. This name is attributed to the Hindu deity Siva, who is often depicted holding a crescent moon on his forehead. Chandrachur represents the divine power and blessings of the moon god.

in_sanskrit.name: चन्द्रचूर्
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who absorbs or drinks the moon's essence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
चन्द्र (Chandra) - moon
चूर् (Chur) - to drink or absorb
Therefore, Chandrachur means 'one who absorbs or drinks the moon's essence'

The name is believed to channel the sacred power of Lord Shiva, promoting blessings, protection, and spiritual growth.
